Package org.apache.spark.sql.connector.expressions

Interface PartitionFieldReference

All Superinterfaces:
Expression, NamedReference
@Evolving public interface PartitionFieldReference extends NamedReference
A reference to a partition field in Table.partitioning().

NamedReference.fieldNames() returns the partition field name (or names) as reported by the table's partition schema. ordinal() returns the 0-based position in Table.partitioning().

Since:
4.2.0
